bug.title: Password reset rejects addresses containing uppercase letters
bug.symptoms: Reset request returns HTTP 500 instead of sending an email Only affects addresses with at least one uppercase character Roughly 4% of reset attempts
bug.reproduction_steps: Register an account as User@example.com Sign out, then request a password reset for that address Observe a 500 response and no email
bug.expected: A reset email is sent to the registered address
bug.actual: HTTP 500; the account lookup returns no row

constraints.constraint: Do not change the public shape of the auth API
Existing stored addresses must keep working unchanged

bug.title: Invoice totals round down on multi-currency line items
bug.symptoms: Invoice total is one minor unit lower than the sum of its lines Only on invoices mixing two or more currencies
bug.reproduction_steps: Create an invoice with one line in EUR and one in USD Compare the rendered total against the sum of the line amounts
bug.expected: The total equals the sum of the converted line amounts
bug.actual: The total is short by one minor unit

bug.title: Database sessions leak under concurrent request load
bug.symptoms: Connection pool exhausts after a few hours of sustained traffic Subsequent requests block until a checkout times out
bug.reproduction_steps: Drive 50 concurrent requests against any read endpoint for ten minutes Watch the pool's in-use count climb and never fall back
bug.expected: Every request returns its session to the pool
bug.actual: Sessions opened inside a nested scope are never closed
bug.constraints: Do not change the pool size defaults

bug.title: Health check reports healthy while the pool is exhausted
bug.symptoms: The readiness endpoint returns 200 while every real request is blocking
bug.reproduction_steps: Exhaust the connection pool, then call the readiness endpoint
bug.expected: Readiness fails when no connection can be checked out
bug.actual: The check never touches the pool, so it always reports healthy
